name: Guangdong Real-Design Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Guangdong Real-Design Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the innovation, manufacturing, and sale of advanced intelligent controllers. These sophisticated control systems are designed for a diverse array of products, encompassing various small household appliances like kitchenware, domestic equipment, and environmental management systems. The company's expertise also caters to medical and health devices, power tools, smart home applications, and other related technologies. In addition to controllers, they also provide complete terminal products. This enterprise, headquartered in Foshan, China, was founded in 1997.
